title: Sunday · the porch from the yard
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The Second Box's Sunday, the week after: the garage porch from the yard, the empty box still on the step, the pup still beside it, rain. Gully's joke, made a landscape.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the garage's small porch from the wet yard, the door, the one step, a cardboard box on the step with its flaps open and nothing in it, the pup sitting beside it, alert.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a small garage porch seen from a wet yard with an open empty cardboard box on the step and a small three-legged dog sitting alertly beside it, rain, no words

panels.name: Porch

panels.composition: Tier 2: the box, close. Empty. Rain on the flaps. On the side, in marker: a scrawl — Gully's hand.
props: the box, marker on the side

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, close on an empty cardboard box on a step with rain darkening its open flaps and a marker scrawl on its side, no words
image.notes: The scrawl is unreadable. Gully's joke: an empty box for the pup to guard. The strip's reconciliation of its two box dates.

panels.name: Box

panels.composition: Tier 3: from farther back: the porch, the box, the pup, the rain, the alley, the tavern's back wall. He's still sitting there. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a wider view of a garage porch in rain with an empty box and a small dog still sitting guard beside it, an alley and a tavern's back wall beyond, no words

panels.name: Guard

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The empty box, guarded. Gully's hand on the side.
